data: 12 controlled histories H01/H02/H03 x SA/SB x fast/slow
protocol: same-time slow-wind observation windows matched against fast-wind source-conditioned windows; compare pointwise RMSE with 1D Wasserstein, quantile distance and empirical CDF/KS distance; windows 5/10/20 s; three time configurations
decision: distribution-level matching occasionally helps longer windows but is mostly equivalent to pointwise matching
the current proxy does not justify distributional consistency as the paper-defining M1
